charts.title: Hand-off workflow DAG
charts.caption: The hand-off workflow — biogears_sepsis.ant handed into TelluriumUTCStep and a surrogate tier, derived by MathExpressionStep, composed and run via the four-verb API.
charts.interpretation: The BioGears sepsis core was extracted to a portable Antimony/SBML file (biogears_sepsis.ant). The workflow hands that file to the Tellurium engine (load file), composes it with a learned surrogate tier over the same spec, and wires the surrogate's ports into a MathExpressionStep derivation. All nodes are registered modules; the pipeline is built and run with the four verbs (list, call, connect, run) — no new simulation code. The yellow box is the hand-off: a portable model artifact is the interface between engines.

charts.title: Four-verb workflow
charts.caption: The four-verb workflow API on one handed-off model (handoff_result.json): list surfaces 76 modules, call loads TelluriumUTCStep in 2.97s, connect wires the surrogate's MAP into the shock node, and run executes the pipeline in 125.2s.
